title: You are Viṣṇu’s brow

words.context: Bhāskara: of Viṣṇu who is the sacrifice, «विष्णोर्यज्ञात्मनो»
Bhāskara: the front-board of the shed, «रराटीम्»
Bhāskara: the side mats; «श्नप्त्रे शोधके», ‘the two purifiers’

words.role: object of an understood verb (‘[I touch / take] you’)

sandhi.rule: a visarga before r is dropped

morphology.note: Bhāskara takes it as from snapti, ‘to purify’, with ś for s; the Saṃhitā spells the cluster श्ञ (a Taittirīya spelling of श्न).

translation.literal: Of Viṣṇu you are the brow; of Viṣṇu you are the back; of Viṣṇu you two are the corners; of Viṣṇu you are the seam; of Viṣṇu you are the fixed; you are Viṣṇu’s; to Viṣṇu you.
translation.readable: You are Viṣṇu’s brow, you are Viṣṇu’s back, you two are Viṣṇu’s corners, you are Viṣṇu’s seam, you are Viṣṇu’s fixed knot; you belong to Viṣṇu — to Viṣṇu, you.

meaning: A string of short yajus formulas (TS 1.2.13.3) said while the havirdhāna, the shed that houses the soma carts, is put together: the shed is treated as Viṣṇu’s body. Bhaṭṭa Bhāskara gives the act for each formula: the front-board is fastened as Viṣṇu’s brow, the middle mat laid as his back, the side mats as the two corners, a cord drawn through as his seam, the door-knot tied as the fixed one; the last words, ‘you are Viṣṇu’s, to Viṣṇu you’, touch the shed, «वैष्णवं हि देवतया हविर्धानम्» — the havirdhāna belongs to Viṣṇu as its deity. The verse addresses the parts of the shed as Viṣṇu’s.
in_the_rite: The third mantra of Budha’s step in the Navagraha sūktam (witness S). S names the adhidevatā and pratyadhidevatā together, so the edition does not say which this formula is for; it names Viṣṇu throughout. Its use for a graha belongs to the later gṛhya tradition.

commentary.label: traditional
commentary.text: Bhāskara gives the act for each part: «रराटीमासञ्जयति» — he fastens the front-board, ‘you are Viṣṇu’s brow’, explained as «विष्णोर्यज्ञात्मनो ललाटमिव प्रधानमसि»; the side mats are «श्नप्त्रे शोधके स्थः», ‘you two are the purifiers’; the knot is «विष्णुना ध्रुवम् अचलितं करणीयम् असि»; and the close, «वैष्णवं हि देवतया हविर्धानम्», is cited from the Brāhmaṇa.

notes.label: linguistic
notes.text: Prose yajus, not verse: a series of nominal sentences with asi, each naming a part of the shed.
